gloss: what kind of; what ~; (with negative) no ~ at all

definitions.explanation: Placed before a noun to ask what sort of thing it is or what it is for.

definitions.gloss: no ~ at all; not the slightest (with a negative)
definitions.explanation: In the pattern {何|なん}の…も + negative, it denies the existence of the thing completely: not a single one, none whatsoever.

examples.english: What kind of book is it?

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}の⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧だろう。
examples.english: I wonder what that sound is.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}の⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain what purpose this meeting is being held for.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}の⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{何|なん}の⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: He was absent without any word at all.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}の⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧うわさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}されたくない→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to be jerked around by rumors with no basis whatsoever.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 always takes the frame {何|なん}の + noun + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ + negative. Dropping the ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ changes it back into a question.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何|なん}の⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: for what purpose; why
- {何|なん}の⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no problem at all
- {何|なん}の⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have nothing to do with it
- {何|なん}の{変哲|へんてつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: utterly ordinary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧: what kind of — asks about qualities; {何|なん}の asks about identity or purpose
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧: something — a pronoun, not a noun modifier
